title.narrative: Work: No Child's Business - Coordination NL

description.narrative: The impact that the Alliance aims to achieve with this programme is that children and youth are free from child labour and enjoy their rights to quality education and (future) decent work, hereby contributing to SDG 8.7.

Work: No Child’s Business’ is aims to make a strong and lasting contribution to the elimination of child labour in Côte d'Ivoire, Uganda, India, Vietnam, Mali and Jordan. The programme is implemented by an alliance that consists of the Stop Child Labour Coalition, UNICEF Netherlands and Save the Children.
